### CVE-2024-21735 — Improper Authorization check in SAP LT Replication Server
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2024-01-09 | Updated: 2025-06-17 | Max CVSS: 7.3
- CWE: CWE-863 CWE-863 Incorrect Authorization
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.3 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:A/AC:H/PR:H/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

SAP LT Replication Server - version S4CORE 103, S4CORE 104, S4CORE 105, S4CORE 106, S4CORE 107, S4CORE 108, does not perform necessary authorization checks. This could allow an attacker with high privileges to perform unintended actions, resulting in escalation of privileges, which has High impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability of the system.



Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP LT Replication Server: affected S4CORE 103; affected S4CORE 104; affected S4CORE 105; affected S4CORE 106; affected S4CORE 107; affected S4CORE 108

References:
- https://me.sap.com/notes/3407617
- https://www.sap.com/documents/2022/02/fa865ea4-167e-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html

### CVE-2024-21737 — Code Injection vulnerability in SAP Application Interface Framework (File Adapter)
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2024-01-09 | Updated: 2025-06-03 | Max CVSS: 8.4
- CWE: CWE-94 CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.4 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:A/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In SAP Application Interface Framework File Adapter - version 702, a high privilege user can use a function module to traverse through various layers and execute OS commands directly. By this, such user can control the behaviour of the application. This leads to considerable impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability.



Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP Application Interface Framework (File Adapter): affected 702

References:
- https://me.sap.com/notes/3411869
- https://www.sap.com/documents/2022/02/fa865ea4-167e-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html

### CVE-2024-22131 — Code Injection vulnerability in SAP ABA (Application Basis)
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2024-02-13 | Updated: 2024-08-01 | Max CVSS: 9.1
- CWE: CWE-94 CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.1 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In SAP ABA (Application Basis) - versions 700, 701, 702, 731, 740, 750, 751, 752, 75C, 75I, an attacker authenticated as a user with a remote execution authorization can use a vulnerable interface. This allows the attacker to use the interface to invoke an application function to perform actions which they would not normally be permitted to perform.  Depending on the function executed, the attack can read or modify any user/business data and can make the entire system unavailable.



Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP ABA (Application Basis): affected 700; affected 701; affected 702; affected 731; affected 740; affected 750; affected 751; affected 752; affected 75C; affected 75I
- sap / sap_aba: affected 700; affected 701; affected 702; affected 731; affected 740; affected 750; affected 751; affected 752; affected 75c; affected 75i

References:
- https://me.sap.com/notes/3420923
- https://www.sap.com/documents/2022/02/fa865ea4-167e-0010-bca6-c68f7e60039b.html

### CVE-2024-25642 — Improper Certificate Validation in SAP Cloud Connector

- CWE: CWE-295 CWE-295: Improper Certificate Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.4 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Due to improper validation of certificate in SAP Cloud Connector - version 2.0, attacker can impersonate the genuine servers to interact with SCC breaking the mutual authentication. Affected:

- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

In SAP Commerce, a user can misuse the forgotten
password functionality to gain access to a Composable Storefront B2B site for

Adobe Document Service allows an attacker with administrator privileges to send a crafted request from a vulnerable web application. It is usually used to target internal systems behind firewalls that are normally inaccessible to an attacker from the external network, resulting in a Server-Side Request Forgery vulnerability. On successful exploitation, the attacker can read or modify any file and/or make the entire system unavailable.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP NetWeaver AS for JAVA (Adobe Document Services): affected ADSSSAP 7.50

### CVE-2024-47590 — Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in SAP Web Dispatcher
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2024-11-12 | Updated: 2024-11-12 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-791 CWE-791: Incomplete Filtering of Special ElementCWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

An unauthenticated attacker can create a malicious link which they can make publicly available. When an authenticated victim clicks on this malicious link, input data will be used by the web site page generation to create content which when executed in the victim's browser (XXS) or transmitted to another server (SSRF) gives the attacker the ability to execute arbitrary code on the server fully compromising confidentiality, integrity and availability.

### CVE-2024-54197 — Server-Side Request Forgery in SAP NetWeaver Administrator (System Overview)
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2024-12-10 | Updated: 2024-12-10 | Max CVSS: 7.2
- CWE: CWE-918 CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.2 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

SAP NetWeaver Administrator(System Overview) allows an authenticated attacker to enumerate accessible HTTP endpoints in the internal network by specially crafting HTTP requests. On successful exploitation this can result in Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) which could have a low impact on integrity and confidentiality of data. It has no impact on availability of the application.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP NetWeaver Administrator(System Overview): affected LM-CORE 7.50

- https://url.sap/sapsecuritypatchday

### CVE-2024-54198 — Information Disclosure vulnerability through Remote Function Call (RFC) in SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2024-12-10 | Updated: 2024-12-10 | Max CVSS: 8.5
- CWE: CWE-914 CWE-914: Improper Control of Dynamically-Identified Variables
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In certain conditions, SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP allows an authenticated attacker to craft a Remote Function Call (RFC) request to restricted destinations, which can be used to expose credentials for a remote service. These credentials can then be further exploited to completely compromise the remote service, potentially resulting in a significant impact on the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the application.

Affected:
- SAP_SE / SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP: affected KRNL64NUC 7.22; affected 7.22EXT; affected KRNL64UC 7.22; affected 7.53; affected KERNEL 7.22; affected 7.54; affected 7.77; affected 7.89; affected 7.93

References:
- https://me.sap.com/notes/3469791
- https://url.sap/sapsecuritypatchday
